timeline.summary: ICICI Bank received a SEBI administrative warning concerning its depository participant activities on May 5, 2026.
RBI approved HDFC Bank to acquire up to 9.95% aggregate holding in ICICI Bank within one year.
ICICI Bank’s **Vivek Ranjan** announced an investor meet at Citi’s 2026 Pan-Asia Conference on May 18, 2026, in-person.

On 18 May 2026, ICICI Bank disclosed that JV partner Prudential Corporation Holdings, holder of 21.91% of ICICI Prudential Life, agreed on 17 May 2026 to buy 75% of Bharti Life for ~₹3,500 Cr, with approvals expected to require it to cut its ICICI Pru Life stake below 10% and cease to be a promoter; ICICI Bank said it will retain its majority holding.
ICICI Bank’s **Deepak Lalingkar** and **Prachiti Lalingkar** scheduled its 16th Annual Investor Conference on May 29, 2026, in-person at 360 ONE Capital (B&K).

ICICI Bank’s **Deepak Lalingkar** and **Prachiti Lalingkar** scheduled investor meets: BofA India Conference (June 1), Morgan Stanley India Forum (June 2), Citi India Conference (June 4), all in-person.
ICICI Bank’s **Jagjivan Mistry** and **Prashant Mistry** announced an in-person investor conference on June 8, 2026, via BSE/NSE disclosure.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹55,991.91 Cr (+16.2% YoY), net profit ₹16,333.18 Cr (+22.3% YoY).

ICICI Bank Limited uploaded audio recordings of media and analysts’ earnings call on Q2FY27 and H1FY27 results at **https://www.icici.bank.in/about-us/news-room** and **https://www.icici.bank.in/about-us/qfr** on **October 17, 2026**, signed by **Vivek Ranjan** (Leadership Team).
ICRA and CARE reaffirmed ICICI Bank's AAA credit ratings and withdrew ratings for matured infrastructure and Tier II bonds.
ICICI Bank Limited received an Order in Appeal confirming a penalty of ₹6,95,418 on October 31, 2026.
